item_name: Rothco All-Purpose Shoulder Strap With Removable Pad
item_short_desc: Whether as a replacement or addition to your bag, Rothco’s Padded Shoulder Strap is a great all-purpose strap you can add to a variety of bags, including a duffle bag, weekend / weekender bag, or messenger bag.
description: Whether as a replacement or addition to your bag, Rothco’s Padded Shoulder Strap is a great all-purpose strap you can add to a variety of bags, including a duffle bag, weekend / weekender bag, or messenger bag. Attach the replacement shoulder strap to your gear with the swivel clips on each end. Measuring 1 ½” wide, the padded shoulder strap can fully extend to 48” long. For added comfort, the all-purpose strap features an 8 ½” X 3” X ½” removable shoulder pad.
